concepts.gloss_en: Completeness/perfection of speech (equated in LM 2:2 with leshon hakodesh, the Holy Tongue)

members.form: שלמות הדבור שהוא בחינת לשון הקדש

reason_for_human: Both occurrences are in the same Torah (LM 2:2) and express the identical idea — שלמות הדבור (completeness of speech) equated with leshon hakodesh; the two surface forms differ only by the equation phrasing 'שהוא לשון הקדש' vs 'שהוא בחינת לשון הקדש', which is the same equation edge, not a semantic difference. The construct head is שלמות הדבור, kept distinct from the different construct שלמות לשון הקדש of LM 1:19. Vocalizations confirm same words (שְׁלֵמוּת הַדִּבּוּר), no homograph issue.
